headline: The butterfly finally left its corridor
lede: Boulder Dash's roaming critter now flaps on its own like the 1984 originals — deterministic, replay-provable, and legally unable to make a predictable patrol unfair. Cave 8, GOSSAMER HOLLOW, is its new home.

notes.text: Butterfly drift: a second critter kind — flaps in open ground, never bores, never ignites. The firefly's door-law and corridor predictability stay exactly as they were (#2456, d29a2d0).
Corridor-invariance by law: in a lined tube every flap candidate is wall, so drift cannot perturb the FLY PIT chicken-game — dashcheck pins 600 ticks of zero flaps there.
dashcheck 184/184 + 198 mutants (new flyDrift silenced goes red); dashplay 49/49 real keys live (100 flaps, tube dip, sealed-lane law, real-key win); watchcheck boulder-dash 320/320.
Caves 1–7 replay byte-identical: flap state rides the hash only where a level opts in (flyExt, the amoExt pattern).
